1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide __that is heterologous to the cell__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo __and the BMC polypeptide is expressed from an exogenous polynucleotide__.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme __that is not naturally associated with the BMC polypeptide in the cell's native state__.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes __from different metabolic pathways__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence __that directs localization of the enzyme to the non-native compartment__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide __derived from a bacterium that does not naturally reside in the cell__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide __and at least one additional Eut polypeptide__.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides __that are each heterologous to the cell__.

9. (Original) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons __and the operons are not naturally present together in the cell__.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag __for purification of the non-native compartment__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide __that is heterologous to the host cell__, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide __for compartmentalizing a metabolic pathway__.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Original) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae __that does not naturally encode the BMC polypeptide__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast __and the yeast does not naturally produce bacterial microcompartments__.

18. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Original) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga __and the alga does not naturally encode the BMC polypeptide__.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product __wherein the enzyme is localized within the non-native compartment__; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product __in an enhanced manner compared to the same enzyme not localized in the compartment__.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product __that is produced at increased levels due to compartmentalization__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor __that is produced at increased levels due to compartmentalization__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production __that is produced at increased levels due to compartmentalization__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate __and the non-native compartment sequesters toxic intermediates__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments __using affinity-based purification__.

27. (Original) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments __wherein each compartment comprises different BMC polypeptides or different enzymes__.
